numbering: Shared theorem counter: Theorem 1, Corollary 2, Theorem 3, Proposition 4, Lemmas 5–11. The DFPWolfe navigation files follow these numbers.

items.label: Theorem 1
items.title: DFP can fail under strong Wolfe conditions
items.mapping: The complete strong-Wolfe counterexample in every dimension n ≥ 2, with the additional failure of all Hölder exponents greater than one half on the initial sublevel.

items.label: Corollary 2
items.title: The counterexample can start from the identity
items.mapping: The complete identity-initialization corollary in every dimension n ≥ 2.

items.label: Theorem 3
items.title: A locally Lipschitz Hessian restores planar convergence
items.mapping: The weak-Wolfe theorem and its strong-Wolfe consequence; finite stationary termination is represented by constant continuation.

items.label: Proposition 4
items.title: Exact formulas for one DFP step
items.mapping: Both exact one-step formulas, independence of τ, and positivity of the two denominators β and γ.

items.label: Lemma 5
items.title: Construct a smooth invariant graph
items.mapping: The full finite-dimensional spectral-radius theorem. Lean assumes C^ν regularity, weaker than the manuscript’s C^(ν+1) hypothesis, and does not assume invertibility.

items.label: Lemma 6
items.title: The two-step map has an invariant C⁷ curve
items.mapping: Agreement with the recovered map, analytic extension, the derivative and eigenvalues 1, −1/9, and 0, and the invariant C⁷ graph with both shape jets and the scale recurrence.

items.label: Lemma 7
items.title: Control amplitude, angle, and center drift
items.mapping: All five components: the O(ε⁶) amplitude remainder, frame rotation, full- and half-cycle center drift, and both within-cycle gradient-angle remainders.

items.label: Lemma 8
items.title: Positive limiting amplitude and a limiting circle
items.mapping: The complete scalar asymptotics theorem, including negative-infinite winding and equality of the full endpoint cluster set with the limiting circle; the circle theorem is also linked separately.

items.label: Lemma 9
items.title: Keep endpoints uniformly separated
items.mapping: The uniform endpoint separation theorem, with one constant valid at every endpoint.

items.label: Lemma 10
items.title: Interpolate with a C², one-half Hölder correction
items.mapping: C² smoothness, zero-extension on the circle, endpoint values and gradients, the O(ε₀) Hessian bound, and global one-half Hölder regularity. Component statements expose the construction hypotheses.

items.label: Lemma 11
items.title: Nonconvergence forces planar secant degeneration
items.mapping: The general positive-definite secant theorem, without a DFP update assumption. Lean’s lam k is the paper’s λₖ₊₁; the bound, limit, matrix boundedness, and smallest-eigenvalue limit are all included.
